events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description:
The pressable that opens the popover, usually a Button. It keeps its own accessible name; the popover only adds
the pressed and expanded state.
props.name: trigger

props.description:
The popover's content: text, a form, a list of actions. Anything the user must be able to dismiss needs a
control of its own when `isDismissable` is false. Plain text is wrapped for the runtime.
props.name: children

props.description:
The popover's heading, which also names it for assistive technology. Without it, name the content with
`aria-label` (web) so a screen reader does not announce an unnamed dialog.
props.name: title

props.description: True to draw an arrow from the content to its trigger. Defaults to false.
props.name: hasArrow

props.description:
True, the default, to close the overlay on a press outside it (the backdrop on a modal, a drawer and a dialog).
Set false for a step the user must finish, and give the content its own close control.
props.name: isDismissable

props.description:
True to keep the Escape key from closing the overlay. It is for a flow with unsaved work or a nested overlay
open, so set it only with `isDismissable` false or a close control in reach. Native has no Escape key, so it
stays unread there unless a component's own page says it maps to the Android back button.
props.name: isKeyboardDismissDisabled

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The side of the trigger it opens on, by reading direction. The runtime flips it when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Where along that side it lines up with the trigger. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: align

props.description: Offset along the alignment axis in pixels
props.name: alignOffset

props.description: Animation configuration. Can be `false`, `"disabled"`, `"disable-all"`, `true`, or `undefined`
props.name: animation

props.description: Whether to render as a child element
props.name: asChild

props.description: Whether to automatically adjust position to avoid screen edges
props.name: avoidCollisions

props.description:
Background layer rendered behind the popover content.
- `undefined` (default): renders `Popover.ContentBackground`, whose
  content is decided by the active library theme
- custom node: replaces the default layer entirely (wrap content in
  `Popover.ContentBackground` to keep the absolute-fill and clipping)
- `null`: removes the background layer
props.name: background

props.description: Additional CSS class for the content container
props.name: className

props.description:
Whether to disable the automatic positioning styles
Useful when you want to handle positioning manually
props.name: disablePositioningStyle

props.description: Whether to force mount the component in the DOM
props.name: forceMount

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description: Screen edge insets to respect when positioning
props.name: insets

props.description: Offset from the trigger element in pixels
props.name: offset

props.description: Custom styles to apply to the positioned content
props.name: style

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID

props.description:
Content width sizing strategy
- 'content-fit': Auto-size to content width (default)
- 'trigger': Match trigger width exactly
- 'full': 100% width
- number: Fixed width in pixels
props.name: width

props.description: All standard React Native View props are supported
props.name: ...ViewProps
